_doc: Regression checklist: named major projects that must stay findable.
validate_data.py checks each against the map + gap report daily.
expect levels (ladder): 'present'  = must be a real map feature;
'tracked'  = feature, pin, or weak/review row in gap_report.
A WARN below expectation is the signal a coverage regression (or a
still-unfixed structural gap) is hiding a major project. Add entries
whenever a user reports a missing project — this file is the memory.
